description: This file contains unit tests for OpenSSL's cryptographic functions, including version checks, counter readings, and algorithm status, using Google Test framework.

methods.name: CryptoTest.Version
methods.description: Test that OPENSSL_VERSION_NUMBER and OPENSSL_VERSION_TEXT are consistent.

methods.name: CryptoTest.Strndup
methods.description: Test the OPENSSL_strndup function with null and zero length.

methods.name: CryptoTest.FIPSCountersEVP
methods.description: Test reading FIPS counters for various EVP cipher functions.

methods.name: CryptoTest.FIPSCountersEVP_AEAD
methods.description: Test reading FIPS counters for EVP_AEAD functions.

methods.name: CryptoTest.QueryAlgorithmStatus
methods.description: Check the status of specific algorithms in FIPS mode.

methods.name: CryptoTest.DeprecatedFunction
methods.description: Test calling a deprecated function without warnings.
